## Description

Device page: battery %, BLE status, firmware version, encrypted offline queue ("2 recordings in encrypted queue"), Sync now, staged firmware update (1.4.2 → 1.5.0) with signed images and rollback/anti-rollback; upload conflict (same session on phone + clip) keeps both and the clinician picks.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Firmware updates only accept signed images; tampered images are rejected (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Offline recordings stay encrypted on the device and sync later without loss (offline suite; exit gate 1).
- [ ] **AC3.** Battery lasts a full clinic day (≥ 8 h mixed use) in a field test (exit gate 2).
- [ ] **AC4.** Upload conflicts surface a choice and never silently merge.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
